summary: Ru–TaN films were deposited using plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) to serve as a Cu diffusion barrier. The films were prepared by sequential deposition of Ru and TaN, with the composition controlled by the number of Ru unit cycles. The amorphous structure of Ru–TaN suppressed Cu diffusion through grain boundaries, enhancing its effectiveness as a diffusion barrier. The films showed good adhesion to both Cu and SiO2.
